answer: Each identity must lock a 500-unit copper bond in a shared atlas registry and present a hardware attestation issued once per device. Forging one fake identity locks 500 units for 30 epochs, and a proven sybil claim slashes 80 percent of that bond. Copying identities multiplies the 500-unit lock per fake and exposes every clone to the same slashing, so an independent grove of jurors detects and penalizes the whole cluster.
